name: hud_low_meter_loop_sound_set_loop_active
description: HudLowMeterLoopSound::SetLoopActive starts or stops the low-meter loop sample only on active-state transitions and mirrors the active flag.
known_limits: VC5 data-symbol coverage is recorded in hud_low_meter_loop_sound_globals; no isolated function-byte comparison is recorded for this HUD helper.
The smoke uses the accepted null-safe zSndSample providers to avoid backend audio setup while validating active-flag transitions and idempotence.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x439b20 validate enabled in ECX, g_Hud_LowMeterLoopActive at 0x4f3750, g_Hud_LowMeterLoopSample at 0x4f374c, PlayA3DSimple(1.0f) only when enabling from inactive, StopActiveVoicesIfPlaying only when disabling from active, and no work for idempotent calls.
The native smoke exercises inactive-to-active, active-to-active, active-to-inactive, and inactive-to-inactive transitions while verifying the mirrored active flag.
